title: Auditable Lifecycle Contracts: Equal-Information Comparison and Applicability-Boundary Evidence
description:
Version 7.0.0 adds the studies_route_a directory: retained Django r79 and Celery r94 equal-information comparison inputs, raw-event and process records, saved verdicts and timing outputs, frozen core and selected strong-baseline source, author-created native adapters, exact upstream and environment identities, and Click/Trio screening and admission records. It supports the manuscript Auditable Lifecycle Contracts for Stateful Software: Equal-Information Comparisons and Applicability Boundaries.

Both methods detected 6/6 observed defect manifestations with 0/18 normal false positives across two historical defect lineages (24 native observations, eight evaluation processes). LCMA pure-decision evaluation was approximately 2.171 and 2.164 times slower. Click remains CONTRACT_BINDING_HOLD; Trio remains PROVENANCE_HOLD_NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FIX_FIRST_PARENT. Depth-1500 failures are retained. No detection, speed, maintenance or production-reliability advantage is claimed.

This is an evidence-inspection and source archive, not a certified one-command cross-machine native reproduction environment. Packaging did not rerun studies. Machine paths were sanitized; original/public hashes and documented metadata excerpts are provided. Historical native orchestration needs environment reconstruction and path rebinding. Full upstream trees, runtimes, third-party issue prose, private engineering data and other manuscripts are not redistributed in this addition. Earlier repository directories remain historical, separately bounded evidence, not additional independent Route A cases.

Author software is BSD-3-Clause; author-derived records and documentation in studies_route_a are CC BY 4.0; upstream notices retain their own terms. The v6.0.0 software and separate data records remain unchanged and do not contain these later records.
